title: Coded machine preserving time and space
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with exactly one work tape. There exists a machine in code normal form whose associated finite machine computes each Boolean output from each Boolean input within a given time bound exactly when $M$ does, and whose total number of work-tape cells visited up to every time $t$ on every input equals that of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
The number of work tapes of $M$ is $1$
